purpose: Document first-party Strasbourg cadastral discovery and bounded anonymous parcel-geometry access.
assessment: The first-party Open Data Strasbourg parcel dataset and API are verified for Strasbourg. Three safe-ID polygons were retained as a bounded sample; this does not establish citywide completeness or production integration.
registryAssessment: Local cadastral-source custodian evidenced by official metadata naming Ville et Eurométropole de Strasbourg and its Géomatique et Connaissance du Territoire service.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official metadata documents parcel scope, producer, fields, GeoJSON EPSG:4326 export, and Etalab open licence.
Official API metadata returned live schema including unique id_parcellaire and geo_shape.
Official anonymous records endpoint returned municipality and spatially bounded parcel records.
